{{Short description|Greek biochemist and politician}}
[[File:Antonios Trakatellis.jpg|thumb|right|Antonios Trakatellis in 2012]]'''Antonios Trakatellis''' ({{langx|el|Αντώνιος Τρακατέλλης}}) (born 4 September 1931 in [[Thessaloniki]]) is a [[Greeks|Greek]] [[Member of the European Parliament]] (MEP), and an academic biochemist. He was elected on the [[New Democracy (Greece)|New Democracy]] ticket and sits with the [[European People's Party]] group. He has been leader of the ND parliamentary group since 2000.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/2182/ANTONIOS_TRAKATELLIS_home.html|title=Antonios TRAKATELLIS {{!}} History of parliamentary service {{!}} MEPs {{!}} European Parliament|website=www.europarl.europa.eu|language=en|access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref>

Trakatellis has been a lecturer at several Greek and [[United States|American]] universities, and was Rector of the [[Aristotle University of Thessaloniki]] 1988-1994. He has published a large number of papers and books concerning [[insulin]], [[nucleic acid]]s, [[protein]]s and [[vitamin B6|vitamin B<sub>6</sub>]] deficiency.

On 20 July 2004 he was elected one of the 14 [[Vice-Presidents of the European Parliament]], ending his mandate on 15 January 2007.

He is the brother of [[Demetrios of America|Demetrios, former Archbishop of America]].
